title: Output-tape return sweep
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Boolean Turing machine, let $x,y$ be Boolean words, and fix encoded selector bits, a simulated configuration $c$ on input $x$, auxiliary tape contents and head positions, an input position $P$ on $y$, an optional simulated state $oq$, an output register $r$, a Boolean tag $b$, and a Boolean word $L$. For every natural number $j$, starting in control state $\mathrm{wret}$ with the output tape storing $j$ ones followed by $L$ and its head at position $j-1$, after $j+1$ steps the control state is $\mathrm{wdec}$, the tape contents are unchanged, and its head is at position $0$.
hypotheses_covered: auxiliary tape contents $\tau_C$ and head position $z_C$
